defect: A Provider ACTION proposal with an invalid owned-file binding or invalid exact-file relative_path was fail-closed immediately instead of receiving a bounded output-contract correction opportunity within the Router-approved model chain.
remediation: treat write-binding and relative-path-binding mismatches as bounded output-contract errors only
rotate correction only through Router-approved models
never persist or execute invalid binding proposals
exhaustion_statement: Invalid write bindings are now correctable only as bounded proposal-contract errors; authority, scope, security, and effect boundaries remain fail-closed.
